reuse_basis.presentation_modifications: If panels are cropped or rearranged in the animation, state cropped/rearranged from Figure 2 or Figure 3 and retain the complete figure link.

panel_display_rois.meaning: Unannotated frame shown in the published diagram; not separately supplied raw camera file
Authors length centerline and green body-area region

figure2.roi_coordinate_units: pixels of the entire published Figure 2 PNG; not original camera-frame/keypoint coordinates
figure2.same_whale_evidence: Visual match of body markings, orientation (tail left, head right), flippers and water features across the figure, supported by the authors workflow caption.
figure2.scene_boundary: Reveal the authors existing panels as a published same-whale processing example. Do not label them as new local model outputs or unmodified raw input data.

figure3.meaning: Authors examples of failed (left) versus successful (right) outputs; failed cases include wake, defecation and kelp.
figure3.scene_boundary: Do not animate left into right as a repair of the identical image. These are example images selected by the authors.

metric_measurement_status.reason: Published figure panels have no linked per-frame altitude/calibration or original image coordinate file. Do not substitute the application default height of 50 m.
metric_measurement_status.bai_note: BAI is scale-free in pixel units, but exact original mask/centerline data are absent; differently scaled published panels are not a substitute.

limited_search.finding: Pinned tree contains application source and environment files, but no sample JPG/PNG/CSV/video files. README links model weights and a tutorial.
limited_search.higher_resolution: Zenodo Figure 2 is 1421x2140, slightly larger than existing local 1372x2080. The embedded PDF Figure 2 image is 1408x2083. Wiley direct HTML request returned 403; no authentication bypass or repeated attempts.
limited_search.tutorial: Official OSU tutorial link https://media.oregonstate.edu/media/1_01o1wp56 was not readable with the web extraction tool; no tutorial video downloaded or reuse license assumed.

not_performed: No raw-movie or mass dataset download
